minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  November 18, 2021

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID 859 3315 5200 and Password 138643 on November 18, 2021 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Dept
  Raul Hernandez, Public Works Department
  Jazmine Covington, Emergency Services

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Misha Davenport DBA The Place of Grace to host CEMM Food Giveaway Event at
  2543 W Manchester Blvd.; The Place of Grace, on Tuesday, November 23, 2021,
  and Wednesday, December 22, 2021 from 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Subject to
  Approval; Applicant to have a minimum of 6 traffic control officers for traffic control /
  ITC in front and around the location. Applicant too hire a minimum of 4 professional
  / licensed security personnel for safety of all attendees & potential crowd control.
  IPD Watch Commander will be notified of this event and extra patrol requested.
  Adhere to all local, state and federal laws. Maintain site at all times ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of each day; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and
  face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA County and CA State Health
  Department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including but not limited to the Americans with
  Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and the California Disabled Persons Act.
  Motion and Seconded (Activity No. 00326841)

Item #2:  Terron Young DBA Brown and Brown Helping Hands to host a Thanksgiving Food
  Drive Event 905 S Prairie Ave., Private Property on Tuesday, November 23, 2021,
   from 10:00 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. Subject to Approval; Applicant to submit a revision site
  map; Applicant to have a minimum of 2 traffic control officers for traffic control / ITC
  in front and around the location. Applicant too hire a minimum of 4 professional /
  licensed security personnel for safety of all attendees & potential crowd control. IPD
  Watch Commander will be notified of this event and extra patrol requested. Adhere
  to all local, state and federal laws. Maintain site at all times ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of each day; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA County and CA State Health
  Department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including but not limited to the Americans with
  Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and the California Disabled Persons Act.
  Motion and Seconded (Activity No. 00326857)

Item #3:  Laverne Smith DBA Little Belize Restaurant to host a Health & Wellness Event at
  217 E Nutwood St., Little Belize Restaurant, on Sunday December 5, 2021, from
  11:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Subject to Approval; Applicant to have a minimum of Four (4)
  traffic control officers for traffic control / ITC, street closure in front and or around the
  location. Applicant must hire two (2) police officers and a minimum six (6)
  professional / licensed security personnel for safety of all attendees & potential
  crowd control. IPD Watch Commander will be notified of this event and extra patrol
  requested. NO alcohol beverages to be served outside the location. Maintain site at
  all times ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of each day;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA County and CA State Health Department; and adhere to all State, Federal,
  LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including but not limited to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights
  Act, and the California Disabled Persons Act. Motion and Seconded (Activity No.
  00326839)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
